## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behaviour. Link the issue or specification section.

## Verification

List the checks actually run and their results. State what remains unverified. Include documentation updates and redacted screenshots only where useful.

## Purchase and recovery implications

If applicable, explain the effect on payment eligibility, recipient/product snapshots, submission guards, provider IDs, polling, cancellation, refunds, and upgrades.

## Checklist

- [ ] Scope is focused and follows the procedural project style.
- [ ] Documentation accurately distinguishes planned and implemented behaviour.
- [ ] Relevant checks pass and limitations are stated.
- [ ] No credentials, customer data, production logs, or private backend source are included.
- [ ] New dependencies, if any, are necessary and compatibly licensed.
